title: selaginella plumosa var. radicata
intro: Selaginella plumosa var. radicata, commonly known as Spike Moss, is a type of evergreen, mat-forming plant belonging to the Selaginellaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis, skin irritation, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Spike Moss are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
